repos_data.description: A curated list of tools, data sources, libraries, and resources for working with SEC filings (13F, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K)
FinData MCP — Financial data via Model Context Protocol. Live market prices, SEC filings, earnings, options flow, macro indicators.
Deterministic SEC filing analytics. Parse, score, and diff 10-K and 10-Q filings. Reproducible JSON scores from text metrics, boolean risk flags, and section diffs.
Find buried material events in SEC 8-K filings the filer did not report. Pure Python regex classifier, no LLM. Powered by FilingFirehose.
The ultimate financial data CLI + MCP server for SEC EDGAR 13F filings, insider trading, and Smart Money convergence signals.
Tracker for U.S. public-company equity stakes in Anthropic and OpenAI. Built from primary SEC filings, court records, and press releases. Each row confidence-tagged (V/P/S).

MCP server for the Filingrail SEC EDGAR API — company financials, insider trades, 8-K events, 13F holdings, and filings for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, and any MCP agent. pip install filingrail-mcp
Read and analyze SEC EDGAR filings in Python. 10-K, 8-K, XBRL financials, Form 3/4/5, 13F, ADV — clean API, well-typed, MIT-licensed.
SEC EDGAR filing MCP for agents - search, preview, purchase (x402).
ShareSeer MCP Server - Access SEC filings and insider transactions via Claude
Corporate credit data for AI agents — Python SDK, LangChain tools, and MCP server
Signal8 MCP Server - SEC filing intelligence for AI agents
